1.1: This the heavy word from the Lord to Israel, straight through His messenger Malachi.
1.2: "I been lovin' y'all," says the Lord. But y'all keep askin', 'How You love us tho?' Wasn't Esau Jacob's brother?" God says. "Yeah, but I chose Jacob. I rocked with him.
1.3: But Esau? Nah. I turned my back on him. I let his whole territory fall apart—his mountains now home to wild jackals.
1.4: And even when Edom tryna clap back like, 'We broke now, but we comin' back—we gon' rebuild all this,' God said, 'Let 'em try. I'll tear down whatever they put up. They gon' stay known as Wicked Territory—folk I stay mad at forever.'
1.5: You gon' see it with your own eyes. And you gon' say, 'God movin' even outside Israel. He big-big.'
1.6: "A son show his daddy some honor, right? And a worker respect his boss? Well if I'm your Father—where's My honor? If I'm your Master—why y'all don't respect Me?" That's what the Lord of Heaven's Armies says to y'all priests who keep disrespectin' His name. But y'all still askin', 'How we disrespected You tho?'
1.7: Y'all bringin' raggedy, defiled food to My altar. But you still ask, 'Wait, what did we do wrong?' You talkin' 'bout My table like it ain't nothin. Like I'm just some regular.
1.8: You bring blind animals as sacrifices. You think that's okay? Lame ones, sick ones too—y'all serious? Try givin' that to your governor and see if he smile at you. See if he take that mess.
1.9: Now you wanna ask Me for favor? You want Me to bless y'all while you disrespectin' Me with these weak offerings? You think I'm takin' that in good faith? For real?"
1.10: "I wish somebody would just shut the temple doors already. Stop wastin' fire on My altar if it ain't comin' from the heart. I'm not feelin' y'all fake worship," says the Lord of Hosts. "I'm not acceptin' nothin from your hands."
1.11: "Let Me make it clear— From sun-up to sun-down, My name gon' be lifted up among the nations. People all over gon' offer Me real incense, real worship, real honor. My name ain't just holy in Israel—it's holy everywhere."
1.12: "But y'all over here treatin' My table like it's trash. Y'all talkin' 'bout the food like it's beneath you.
1.13: You rollin' your eyes like it's a burden to even serve. You act like bringin' Me an offering is too much work. And then you got the nerve to bring Me stolen stuff? Or them busted, sick animals? You think I'ma bless that? You serious?"
1.14: "Cursed is the one who got a good offering in his stash, Makes a promise to give it to Me, Then turns around and gives Me the busted one instead. Don't play Me like that. I'm a Great King," says the Lord of Hosts. "My name deserves reverence—even the nations fear Me."

2.1: "Aight now, this one right here? This commandment for y'all priests."
2.2: "If y'all don't listen up, And if y'all don't take Me serious and give Me the glory I deserve," Says the Lord of Heaven's Armies, "I'ma curse what was supposed to bless y'all. Matter fact, it's already cursed—'cause y'all hearts ain't in it."
2.3: "Watch this—I'ma check your descendants, And straight up smear dung on y'all faces— Yeah, the same mess from them so-called holy festivals. And y'all gon' get dragged out with it."
2.4: "Then maybe y'all'll realize I meant what I said. I gave this word so My covenant with Levi would stay solid," Says the Lord of Hosts.
2.5: "That covenant was about life and peace, And I gave it to him so he'd respect Me. And he did. He feared Me for real. He honored My name."
2.6: "He spoke truth. He ain't twist nothin'. He walked close with Me, stayed fair, And turned a bunch of folks away from sin."
2.7: "See, a priest's mouth supposed to keep wisdom ready. People should be able to come to y'all for God's law. You the messenger—I trusted you with My word."
2.8: "But you? You swerved off the path. You out here makin' people trip over the Word. You broke the Levi covenant," Says the Lord of Hosts.
2.9: "So guess what? I made you look foolish in front of everybody. You ain't follow My ways, And you pick and choose who gets justice."
2.10: Ain't we all got the same Father? Ain't the same God make all of us? So why we doin' each other dirty, And actin' like we forgot our ancestors' covenant?
2.11: Judah wildin'. Israel and Jerusalem too—straight up disrespect. They out here messin' up what God said was holy. Judah married some foreign-god worshipper, And God ain't havin' it.
2.12: May the Lord cut off anybody in Jacob's crew Who does that mess— Even if they wide awake and still bringin' offerings like it's cool.
2.13: And here's the second thing y'all do: Y'all cryin' and weepin' at the altar, Tears everywhere, but God not listenin'. He not takin' them offerings no more, Not with love. Not with favor.
2.14: And you ask, "But why tho?" 'Cause the Lord saw what you did. You played dirty with the wife of your youth— The one you made a covenant with. She was your partner, man. Your rib.
2.15: Didn't God make y'all one? He gave y'all His Spirit so y'all could produce godly kids. That's why He joined y'all like that. So take care of your spirit— And don't go cheatin' on the one you started with.
2.16: "I, the Lord God of Israel, hate divorce. It stains your robe with violence," Says the Lord of Hosts. "So guard your spirit, And stop movin' grimy."
2.17: Y'all makin' God tired with all this talk. And still you say, "What we say that wore Him out?" It's when y'all start sayin' stuff like: "Evil people blessed. God must be cool with 'em." Or, "Where God at? Where the justice?"

3.1: Look, I'm sendin' My messenger ahead of Me— He gon' clear the path. And the Lord y'all been lookin' for? Yeah, He comin' to His temple. The Messenger of the covenant—the One y'all claim to be hype about? He on His way," says the Lord of Heaven's Armies.
3.2: But let's be real—who can handle it when He shows up? Who gon' still be standin' when He steps in? He comin' like fire in a furnace, Like bleach on dirty clothes.
3.3: He gon' sit down like a silversmith, Refinin' and purifyin' the Levites— Burnin' off the grime like gold and silver So they can bring offerings that actually mean somethin'.
3.4: Then the gifts from Judah and Jerusalem Gon' be somethin' God can smile on again— Just like back in the good ol' days.
3.5: And I ain't just showin' up to chill— I'm comin' with judgment. I'ma be quick to testify Against the sorcerers, the cheaters, The liars, the ones robbin' workers, widows, and orphans, And the ones who treat strangers like trash— All 'cause they don't fear Me," says the Lord of Hosts.
3.6: "I'm the Lord—I don't change. That's the only reason y'all ain't been wiped out, Sons of Jacob.
3.7: Since your great-great-granddaddies' day, Y'all been wildin'— Turnin' away from My rules, Not keepin' what I said. Come back to Me, and I'll come back to you," Says the Lord of Hosts. But y'all over here talkin' 'bout, "How we supposed to come back?"
3.8: Can a human rob God? Well guess what? Y'all robbin' Me. And still y'all ask, "How we robbin' You?" Through tithes and offerings. That's how.
3.9: Y'all under a curse— The whole nation—'cause you been stealin' from Me.
3.10: Bring the full tithe into the storehouse, So there's food in My house. Test Me on this one," Says the Lord of Hosts. "See if I don't crack open the windows of heaven And pour out blessings you ain't even got room for.
3.11: I'll shut down the devourer for y'all. He won't be eatin' up your crops, Or stoppin' your vines from producin'," Says the Lord of Hosts.
3.12: "Everybody gon' call y'all blessed, 'Cause your land gon' be that beautiful," Says the Lord of Hosts.
3.13: "But y'all been talkin' slick about Me," Says the Lord. And y'all still got the nerve to ask, "What we say that was wrong?"
3.14: You said, "Ain't no point servin' God. What we get outta keepin' His commandments? All this mournin' and repentant stuff ain't payin' off."
3.15: "Now we call the proud 'blessed,' The ones actin' foul get promoted, And the ones testin' God ain't even gettin' checked."
3.16: But then the ones who actually feared God Started talkin' to each other. And God leaned in—He heard every word. So He had a book of remembrance written— For the folks who fear Him And keep His name close to heart.
3.17: "They Mine," says the Lord of Hosts. "On the day I show out, They gon' be like My jewels— I'ma spare them like a father who spares his faithful son."
3.18: Then you'll finally see the difference— Between the righteous and the wicked, Between the one who serves God And the one who don't even try.

4.1: Look, the day is comin'— Hot like a furnace. All the proud folk and the ones wildin'? They gon' burn up like dry grass. That day gon' blaze through 'em," Says the Lord of Heaven's Armies, "Leavin' nothin' behind—not even roots or branches.
4.2: But for the ones who respect My name? The Sun of Righteousness gon' rise— He bringin' healin' in His wings. Y'all gon' run out like calves fresh out the pen— Fed, full, and free.
4.3: You gon' stomp down the wicked— They gon' be dust under your feet On the day I step in," Says the Lord of Hosts.
4.4: Don't forget the Law of Moses, My servant— The same commandments I gave him at Mount Horeb For all y'all in Israel. Hold on to them statutes and judgments.
4.5: I'm sendin' Elijah the prophet to y'all Before the great and heavy day of the Lord shows up.
4.6: He gon' flip hearts— Fathers turnin' back to their kids, And kids back to their fathers— So I don't have to come through And strike the earth with a curse.
